reasoning_disable_mechanism.structural_note: Model documentation independently confirms gemma-4-26b-a4b-it has a 'built-in thinking mode that lets the model reason step-by-step before answering' — i.e. this is a reasoning-tuned model by design, the same class of model whose chain-of-thought this project's own Nemotron work (docs/v2/PHASE2_CLOSURE_REPORT.md §13/§24) found dominates both latency AND token cost, and whose equivalent 'disable thinking' controls (Nemotron's /no_think prompt trick, and later its real thinking_mode SDK parameter) were BOTH found unreliable in this project's own live tests (worked once, failed once). No independent, live confirmation exists this session that enable_thinking:false reliably suppresses Gemma-4's reasoning trace on Workers AI — it is a documented parameter, not a verified-reliable one.
reasoning_disable_mechanism.billing_relevance: Cloudflare's own pricing material states reasoning/thinking tokens are billed as OUTPUT tokens even when not retained/shown in the final response content ('Output is billed separately from context growth because reasoning tokens are not always retained.') — this is a plausible, structurally sound mechanism for exactly the kind of large, silent overcharge multiple community reports describe (see step3).
